prompts.title: GPT API
prompts.prompt:
Create one finished square 1:1 raster cover, at least 1024x1024, for the Lhie Store storefront and Telegram family artwork. Use the attached existing store artwork ONLY as visual reference for the original chibi anime mascot language, rich cozy architectural settings, premium anime illustration finish, and store signature. This is a NEW family cover, not an edit. Chibi boy with tousled dark brown hair, warm brown eyes, oversized head and expressive face, modest hoodie and sneakers, accompanied by a small cute black cat. Original characters. Beautiful hand-drawn anime contours, painterly interior lighting, precise readable display typography. Restrained lighting rather than neon. Brand palette connects warm cream #fffdf8, ink #0b1220, electric blue #005cff and small buttery yellow accents, adapted to the specific scene. Make title huge, crisp and readable at 160px thumbnail. All essential text, face and main motif inside central 76% width and height, 12% margin on each edge. Opaque background. Only text explicitly requested below may appear. No price, token quota, duration, date, restock, supplier name or domain, endpoint, API key, promotional slogan, official status, warranty, refund, endorsement or partnership claim. No corporate logos on clothing or devices, no combined brand marks, no random code, fake terminals, robots, brains, generic chips, glowing spheres, flags, stereotypes, decorative Chinese script, blue-purple gradients or glassmorphism. Avoid excessive sparkles and crowded decoration. Hands must be clean and plausible, objects distinct, lettering spelled correctly.
Specific cover 1 of a coherent three-cover series. Main title EXACTLY “GPT API”, on two large lines centered in the upper half, warm ivory bold letters with dark ink outline and a restrained blue dimensional edge. Do NOT rename it ChatGPT Plus or Codex. Scene: a sunlit botanical atelier with arched cream windows, a few trailing leaves, and a compact blue drafting desk. In the lower central half, the chibi boy in an ivory hoodie with blue cuffs sits sideways on a blue stool, smiling at the viewer while holding a large blue folio; three thick blank paper tabs rise from it to suggest a single model family with multiple choices. The black cat sits alert beside the folio. Broad serene shapes and warm sunlight, blue and leaf-green accents, no floating company icons. Keep desk details minimal so the title and character dominate. A small but legible brush-signature panel centered near y=84% reads EXACTLY “LhieStore” in white script on dark blue, with a tiny hand-drawn crown above. No additional text.
